usage: ai-effort-ledger <command> [<subcommand>] [options]

Measure the human time and the agent time of a person from the native logs of the agent tools.

options:
  --store FOLDER      use another store folder for this command only
  --json              write the result as one JSON document
  --language {en,it}  the language of the output
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit

commands:
  <command>
    setup             prepare the ledger on a machine
    schedule          show, create, or remove the scheduled ingestion
    ingest            run an ingestion
    machine           the label of the machine in its store metadata
    config            show the configurations, or append an entry to the person configuration
    sessions          list the sessions of a local day
    annotate          write an annotation
    entry             write a manual entry
    timesheet         show the timesheet of a day, or confirm or retract it
    entries           list the declared events of a local day
    retract           retract an event by its event identifier
    purge             remove events from the store
    report            the reports of the ledger
    frozen            the frozen reports
    index             the local index of the store
    version           show the version of the ledger and of tzdata
